C0776.title: E-Commerce Cloud Warehouses Implanted with Trojan Software to Steal Express Delivery Label Data
C0776.summary: From April 2022, the Yuyao Public Security Bureau in Zhejiang cracked China's first case of using Trojan software to steal express delivery waybill data from e-commerce cloud warehouses. A gang led by Bao and Gao, with Ma as the installer and Xie as the upstream supplier, infiltrated delivery cloud warehouses nationwide by temporary hiring or sneaking in at night, implanting Trojans on waybill-printing computers to steal label data in real time. The data was packaged by 'material brokers' and resold to overseas fraud rings, with a single label marked up to 5.5-7 yuan. 35 suspects were arrested with over 30 million yuan involved.
